title: Towards Comprehensive Argument Analysis in Education: Dataset, Tasks, and Method
reasoning: The paper focuses on the structural analysis of arguments in educational essays (argument mining). While some essay topics in the dataset touch on philosophical or spiritual themes (e.g., 'ritual' or 'the meaning of life'), the research objectives and benchmarking tasks are focused on linguistic and structural components (component detection, relation prediction) rather than an evaluation or benchmarking of religion, morals, or ethics.
